dataset: StatsBomb Open Data, cached event + shot freeze-frame data
prompt: The diagram shows a soccer shot at contact. Goal is at the top. Gold star: shooter. Blue circles: teammates. Red circles: opposing outfield players. Orange square: opposing goalkeeper. Estimate the probability of a goal from this situation. Body part, ball height and previous motion are not supplied.
representation: New deterministic 512x512 Pillow half-pitch renderer; identical for both supervised arms. Not the legacy benchmark renderer.
model_inputs: Only positional diagram and fixed generic prompt. No body part, numerical coordinates, outcome, xG reference, match/competition identity or previous predictions.
objective: Unweighted binary cross-entropy on observed goal/no-goal; sigmoid probability at inference. No generated numeric targets or teacher xG labels.

training.adapter_modules: Text attention q_proj/v_proj only; vision encoder frozen

test_policy: Test labels are not loaded by training/checkpoint selection; separate explicit evaluation after both arms are fixed.
interpretation: Exploratory supervised study on previously used matches. Training/validation/test are disjoint here, but this is not independent confirmation of earlier zero-shot studies.

budget.note: No automatic paid service or GPU rental; local compute has no token bill.

provenance.license: See StatsBomb repository LICENSE.pdf; retain attribution in publications.
